es.title: Carta de cobro legal
es.outcome: Carta formal que precede acciones legales.
es.prompt:
Un cliente no me paga y necesito enviarle una carta formal antes de tomar acciones legales.

Deuda: [monto y desde cuándo].
Servicio prestado: [describir].
Intentos previos de cobro: [listar].

Dame: carta formal de requerimiento de pago, plazo razonable para pagar, consecuencias claras si no paga, tono firme pero profesional y opciones de pago para facilitar el acuerdo.

en.title: Formal demand letter (pre-litigation)
en.outcome: Formal letter that precedes legal action.
en.prompt:
A client hasn't paid me and I need to send a formal letter before taking legal action.

Debt: [amount and since when].
Service provided: [describe].
Previous collection attempts: [list].

Give me: a formal demand letter for payment, a reasonable deadline to pay, clear consequences if they do not pay, a firm but professional tone, and payment options to facilitate a settlement.
